definitions.gloss: to use up completely; to exhaust; to spend all
definitions.explanation: To consume or expend something entirely until nothing remains.

examples.japanese: {貯金|ちょきん}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たした。
examples.english: I used up all my savings.

examples.japanese: {体力|たいりょく}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たして{倒|たお}れた。
examples.english: I collapsed after completely exhausting my energy.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}で{予算|よさん}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up spending my entire budget on the trip.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

- {使|つか}い{果|は}たさない (negative)
- {使|つか}い{果|は}たして (te-form)
- {使|つか}い{果|は}たした (past)

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {貯金|ちょきん}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たす - to use up one's savings
- {体力|たいりょく}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たす - to exhaust one's energy
- {予算|よさん}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たす - to spend the entire budget
- {資源|しげん}を{使|つか}い{果|は}たす - to deplete resources

COMPOUND VERB:
{果|は}たす adds the meaning of "completely" or "to the end."
